ValidationRule.description: IM-52: Restrict the status selection to either Ongoing or Completed if the Approved field is Checked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.IM_Initiative_Validation__c && AND( Approved__c == TRUE, NOT(ISPICKVAL( Status__c , 'Ongoing')), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Status__c , 'Completed')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Status can only be either Ongoing or Completed after Initiative Final Approval.
